calendar.frequent: Run more often than hourly, so not in the calendar:

at.hours: {count, plural, one {Every hour} other {Every # hours}} at :{minute}

dependencies.name: Dependency updates every night
dependencies.description: Bump patch and minor versions, run the tests, open a pull request if anything changed.
dependencies.prompt: Check the outdated dependencies. Bump the patch and minor versions, run the test suite and open a pull request if anything changed. Leave major versions to a person, but list them in the description.

changelog.name: Changelog draft every week
changelog.description: Turn the pull requests merged this week into CHANGELOG entries.
changelog.prompt: Collect the pull requests merged since last week and write CHANGELOG entries for them, grouped by the kind of change.

flaky.name: Flaky test hunt
flaky.description: Run the suite several times, fix or skip the tests that fail only sometimes.
flaky.prompt: Run the test suite five times. For each test that fails only sometimes, find the cause and fix it; if you cannot, skip it with a comment that says why.

security.name: Fix vulnerable dependencies
security.description: Audit the dependencies and fix the high and critical advisories.
security.prompt: Run the package manager's audit. For each high or critical advisory, upgrade to the smallest version that fixes it and run the tests.

docs.name: Docs drift check
docs.description: Find where the README and the docs no longer match the code.
docs.prompt: Compare the README and the docs with the code. Fix what no longer matches: commands, options, file names and examples.

deadCode.name: Dead code sweep
deadCode.description: Remove unused exports, files and dependencies.
deadCode.prompt: Find unused exports, files and dependencies and remove them. Run the type check and the tests before you finish.

automations.name: Name
automations.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
automations.runsWorkflow: Each run starts the workflow {workflow} with an empty request, as Run does without one. Its agent steps take their settings from the workflow.
automations.promptPlaceholder: Describe what the agent should do on each run.
automations.runsTask: Each run is an ordinary task named after the automation, in its own worktree: it waits in the queue like any other and ends in a pull request to review, never merged on its own.
automations.enabledHint: A paused automation keeps its settings and does not run until it is turned on.
automations.wouldRun: Paused; turned on, it would run:
automations.noUpcoming: The cron matches no minute in the next year.

builtin.fixed: It is built into OLIMP: you can turn it off or change its schedule, agent and prompt, but not rename or delete it.

weave.name: Memory weaving
weave.hint: Weaves the notes agents leave after their tasks into the project's memory pages, oldest first. On its schedule it runs only when more than 10 notes wait or the oldest is over a week old.

lint.name: Memory lint
lint.hint: Checks the project's memory for contradictions, claims the code no longer bears out, repeats, pages no hub links to and broken links, and fixes what it can. On its schedule it runs only when the memory changed since the last check.

scripts.title: Worktree scripts
scripts.hint: Bash run around each job's worktree: to prepare it before the agent starts and to clean up before it goes.
scripts.consent: These scripts belong to this project only. By saving them you let OLIMP run them as its own system user, with that user's rights on this machine; only an admin can edit them.
scripts.runtime: They run one after another in the worktree folder, in Bash without a terminal (Bash has to be installed). A script's exit code is its result; put set -e first to stop at the first command that fails. Saving checks each script's syntax with Bash. Without a limit a script gets 30 minutes.
scripts.environment: The worktree's facts come as environment variables, quoted as in any Bash script, e.g. cd "$OLIMP_WORKTREE_PATH"; OLIMP's own variables are left out.

afterCreate.title: When a worktree is created
afterCreate.hint: Run after a worktree is created and before its agent starts, also when a kept worktree is created again for a continuation. A failing script fails the task with its output.

beforeRemove.title: When a worktree is removed
beforeRemove.hint: Run while the worktree's files still exist, before it is removed after its job, by Reclaim now or by hand. A failing script keeps the folder for recovery.

scripts.none: No scripts: this phase passes without running anything.
scripts.name: Display name (optional)

vars.OLIMP_PROJECT_PATH: The project's folder: its own checkout or OLIMP's clone.
vars.OLIMP_WORKTREE_PATH: This worktree's folder; the script starts in it.
vars.OLIMP_JOB_ID: The task or workflow run the worktree is for; a continuation's is its thread's first task.
vars.OLIMP_BRANCH: The worktree's branch, e.g. olimp/ and the job's id.

scripts.invalid: Every script needs its Bash, and a timeout is 1 to {max} minutes.
scripts.adminOnly: Only an admin changes worktree scripts.

repo.seededHint: Copied into each task's worktree, which git would otherwise leave without it.
repo.localFileHint: Local and git-ignored: it stays on this machine and is never committed, so tasks in a worktree do not see it; tasks in the checkout do.
repo.localSeededHint: Local and git-ignored: it stays on this machine and is never committed. OLIMP copies it into each task's worktree when git ignores it, so it applies at once.
repo.mcpScopesHint: Managed by claude mcp add in ~/.claude.json; OLIMP shows their names and does not edit Claude's state file.
repo.mcpLocalNote: Local servers apply only where Claude runs in the project's own folder, not in task worktrees.
repo.agentMissingHint: {agent} is not installed: its files can be edited, but its tasks will not start until it is.
repo.memoryHint: Off, agents know the project from its own files, such as AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. On, every agent step gets tools to search and read the project's memory when it needs to and to leave notes there, and the memory weaving and lint run.
repo.areasHint: Other projects whose memory is shared knowledge of this one, such as a company's or a person's. Agent steps here reach that memory with the same tools, beside the project's own.
repo.areasNone: No other project yet: add one, e.g. a folder for the company's knowledge, to share its memory.
repo.initGitHint: With git the folder gets a history, and every task gets a branch of its own. OLIMP makes a first commit of the files as they stand, without node_modules and .env files, and sends nothing anywhere.

addTests.text: Add tests that cover this change, including the edge cases, and run them.

explain.label: Walk through the change
explain.text: When you finish, explain what you changed and why, file by file, in plain words.

minimal.label: Keep it minimal
minimal.text: Keep the change minimal: touch only what the task needs, no refactoring on the side.

docs.label: Update docs
docs.text: Update the README and the docs the change affects.

edgeCases.label: Mind the edge cases
edgeCases.text: Before you finish, check the edge cases: empty input, errors, limits and concurrent use.

prompt.dispatchHint: Split this task into subtasks run as separate tasks, then merge them.
prompt.dispatchNote: OLIMP enforces the number of subtasks and how many run at once; the budget only tells the agent how big to make each subtask.
prompt.modelsError: Could not load the models; is the API up to date?

compare.title: Variants
compare.hint: The same prompt in {count} variants: compare them and keep the diff you like.
compare.runningHint: The same prompt in {count} variants; you can pick once all have finished.
compare.pickedHint: The kept variant stays; the others are archived, with their pull requests closed.
compare.closeFailed: Some pull requests could not be closed; close them on GitHub:

mail.serverHint: The password is stored encrypted with the installation's key and never shown again.
mail.offHint: Until it is, invitations, password resets and sign-in codes by e-mail do not go out.
mail.secureHint: For port 465 (smtps). Off, OLIMP switches to TLS with STARTTLS when the server offers it, as on port 587.
mail.passwordKept: Saved; an empty field keeps it
mail.fromHint: The From address, optionally with a name: {example}.
mail.savedHere: Saved in the panel; it replaces OLIMP_SMTP_URL and OLIMP_MAIL_FROM.
mail.fromEnvironment: From the environment (OLIMP_SMTP_URL, OLIMP_MAIL_FROM); saving here replaces it.
mail.testHint: Sends a short message through the server above.

flow.reviewersInPrompt: {logins}: named only in the prompt, which does not request a review. Add them to the reviewers of the PR update step.
flow.reviewersInPromptNoUpdate: {logins}: named only in the prompt, which does not request a review. A PR update step with reviewers does.
flow.endFailedHint: Finishes the run with a failure.

field.name: Name
field.templateHint: '{{task}}' is the run's request; '{{nodes.ID.OUTPUT}}' reads an earlier node.
field.startHint: Every run starts here. Its request is '{{task}}' in the prompts of the steps after it.
field.loopHint: The loop repeats while visited at most this many times (1 to {max}); then it leaves by exhausted.
field.reviewHint: Judges the run's branch and changes nothing.
field.budgetHint: A hint in the subtask's prompt, not a hard limit.
field.verdictsHint: Separate with commas; every verdict gets its own port. The agent's last line is OLIMP:VERDICT followed by one of them.
field.sessionHint: Continue another agent node's Claude session instead of a fresh one.
field.allowedToolsHint: Claude only: replaces its tool list for this step.
field.bashAllowlistHint: One per line, asked for beside the project's check commands.
field.commandHint: Runs in a shell in the run's worktree with the project's secrets; exit code 0 passes.
field.retryOnHint: Only these codes leave by fail; any other fails the run. Empty: every non-zero code.
field.conditionHint: The changes count against where the run's branch left its base.
field.globHint: * within a folder, ** across folders, ? one character.
field.question: Question
field.optionsHint: One per line, up to {max}; a typed answer works too.
field.timeoutHint: Empty waits without one; with one the node gets a timeout port.
field.branchesHint: Each branch is an agent run as a subtask from the run's branch.
field.waitAll: All branches finished (succeeds only if each did)
field.waitAny: One branch succeeded (the others get cancelled)
field.subWorkflowHint: Another workflow of this project, run from this run's branch.
field.issueHint: Empty: the issue an agent step named with a line OLIMP:ISSUE and its number.
field.urlHint: HTTPS, or $'{NAME}' for a secret of the project, so the address stays out of the workflow.

start.label: Start
start.description: The entry: receives the run's request as '{{task}}'.

end.label: End
end.description: Ends the run as done or failed.

loop.label: Loop
loop.description: Bounded repeat: every cycle goes through one, which leaves by exhausted after max rounds.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: One agent session in the run's worktree: prompt, skill, agent, model, optional verdicts.

check.label: Check
check.description: A shell command in the worktree: exit code 0 passes.

gateHuman.label: Human gate
gateHuman.description: Waits for your approve or reject, holding no worker slot.

askUser.label: Ask user
askUser.description: Asks you a question and goes on with the answer.

dispatch.label: Hand off a subtask
dispatch.description: Starts a subtask in a worktree of its own, branched from the run, and waits until it ends.

fork.label: Fork
fork.description: Splits into 2 to 4 agents that run at once as subtasks; every branch leads into one join.

join.label: Join
join.description: Fork branches end here; it waits for every branch or for the first success.

workflow.label: Sub-workflow
workflow.description: Runs another workflow of the project as a sub-run and waits for it.

if.label: If
if.description: Branches on the run's changes, the changed paths, a node's output or the base branch.

gitCommit.label: Commit
gitCommit.description: Records all changes in the worktree as a commit.

gitPush.label: Push
gitPush.description: Commits anything pending, then pushes the run's branch to origin.

gitSyncBase.label: Sync with base
gitSyncBase.description: Brings in the newest base branch; on a conflict it stops so an agent can sort it out.

githubDraftPr.label: Pull request
githubDraftPr.description: Pushes the branch and opens a pull request through gh, a draft by default.

githubPrUpdate.label: Update PR
githubPrUpdate.description: Marks the run's pull request ready, adds labels, requests reviewers.

githubPrComment.label: PR comment
githubPrComment.description: Comments on the run's pull request.

githubIssueComment.label: Issue comment
githubIssueComment.description: Comments on an issue: the node's, or the one an agent named with OLIMP:ISSUE.

githubWaitCi.label: Wait for CI
githubWaitCi.description: Waits until the pull request's checks pass or fail, up to a timeout.

notifyWebhook.label: Webhook
notifyWebhook.description: POSTs a JSON message to an HTTPS address.
